description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Panaiyaruppan, Manmunai D/S Division, Batticaloa District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations of land ownership for specific parcels of land in the Batticaloa District. It involves declarations under the Registration of Title Act regarding title settlements for numerous land parcels, including their extent, ownership status, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations, property ownership, and land titles.
